answer.reason: The verses only list Iezer among the sons of Gilead and name his clan in a lot and a tribal reference, saying nothing he did or that happened to him beyond the summary.
doubts: JDG 6:34 and JDG 8:2 speak of the clan of Abiezer, not of Iezer himself, and 1CH 7:18 may concern a different Abiezer.
